LanguageData.IRBM_Missile_Object.label: missile
LanguageData.IRBM_ReconSatellite_Object.label: recon satellite
LanguageData.IRBM_ReconSatellite_Object.description: An orbital reconnaissance satellite deployed via missile. It can maintain high-altitude observation over a target location, keeping the map loaded.
LanguageData.IRBM_EnergyBeamSatellite_Object.label: orbital energy beam satellite
LanguageData.IRBM_EnergyBeamSatellite_Object.descript: An orbital platform equipped with a high-power microwave emitter. It can focus a massive column of electromagnetic energy onto a target location on the surface.
LanguageData.IRBM_BombardmentSatellite_Object.label: orbital bombardment satellite
LanguageData.IRBM_BombardmentSatellite_Object.descrip: An orbital platform designed for precision saturation strikes. It is equipped with a magazine of kinetic impactors that can be dropped onto target coordinates.
LanguageData.IRBM_TractorSatellite_Object.label: quantum entanglement tractor satellite
LanguageData.IRBM_TractorSatellite_Object.description: A specialized orbital platform equipped with high-energy quantum entanglement projectors. It can create a momentary link between two distant points in space-time, allowing for the instantaneous mass transport of all items from one map to a specific location on another. This process is non-destructive and preserves all physical properties of the transported objects.
LanguageData.IRBM_ObservedArea.label: observed area
LanguageData.IRBM_ObservedArea.description: An area currently under satellite surveillance.
LanguageData.IRBM_HeisenbergRelay.label: Heisenberg relay station
LanguageData.IRBM_HeisenbergRelay.description: A highly advanced, automated signal relay station. It is directing the Heisenberg Protocol strikes against your colony. Destroying all such stations is the only way to terminate the protocol.
